cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_questionnaire_snapshots_worker C)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(NOT TARGET test_questionnaire_snapshots)
add_library(questionnaire_snapshots STATIC "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/src/base/cui_questionnaire_snapshots.c")
target_link_libraries(questionnaire_snapshots PUBLIC cui)
cui_warnings(questionnaire_snapshots)
add_executable(test_questionnaire_snapshots "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_questionnaire_snapshots.c")
target_link_libraries(test_questionnaire_snapshots PRIVATE questionnaire_snapshots)
cui_warnings(test_questionnaire_snapshots)
add_test(NAME questionnaire_snapshots COMMAND test_questionnaire_snapshots)
file(READ "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/QUESTIONNAIRE_SNAPSHOTS.md" guide)
string(REGEX MATCH "```c\n([^`]+)```" example "${guide}")
if(NOT CMAKE_MATCH_1)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing snapshots C example")
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/questionnaire_snapshots_guide.c" "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
add_library(questionnaire_snapshots_guide OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/questionnaire_snapshots_guide.c")
target_link_libraries(questionnaire_snapshots_guide PRIVATE questionnaire_snapshots)
cui_warnings(questionnaire_snapshots_guide)
include(CheckLanguage)
check_language(CXX)
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER)
 enable_language(CXX)
 add_library(questionnaire_snapshots_header OBJECT "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_questionnaire_snapshots_header.cpp")
 target_link_libraries(questionnaire_snapshots_header PRIVATE questionnaire_snapshots)
 target_compile_features(questionnaire_snapshots_header PRIVATE cxx_std_11)
 cui_warnings(questionnaire_snapshots_header)
endif()

endif()
